packageRules.description: Build/test tooling: patch + minor land on their own once CI is green. minimumReleaseAge keeps us off same-day releases, which is where supply-chain incidents surface.

Runtime dependencies ship to users, so CI (lint, type-check, build, unit tests) is the gate: patch + minor land on their own once it is green. minimumReleaseAge keeps us off same-day releases, which is where supply-chain incidents surface.
Majors are breaking by definition: one PR each, so the changelog is readable and a revert is surgical.
Vue, Vite and the TS toolchain move in lockstep; splitting them produces PRs that cannot pass CI on their own.
Engine constraint, not a dependency — bumping it changes what CI and contributors must run.
